Contribute to the architecture and interface design of Windows-specific and cross-platform components and their integration with higher-level products. Maintain and continuously improve the Kernel Team’s existing codebase, drivers, and components, ensuring timely resolution of defects and technical issues. Excellent English communication and cross-functional collaboration skills Who You Are Analytical and solution-oriented, with a structured approach to solving complex problems. Hands-on and accountable, with a strong sense of ownership and commitment to delivering quality results. Collaborative and communicative, able to build effective relationships and work well with colleagues across teams. Adaptable and proactive, comfortable managing changing priorities and working in a fast-paced environment. Pragmatic and improvement-focused, always looking for effective ways to improve processes, solutions, and team outcomes.
